title: From Insight to Action: A Novel Framework for Interpretability-Guided Data Selection in Large Language Models
authors_zh: Ling Shi、Xinwei Wu、Xiaohu Zhao 等（天津大学、阿里巴巴集团）
paper_type_zh: 可解释性驱动的数据选择与监督微调研究
best_for_zh: 适合希望把模型内部机制转化为推理训练数据筛选规则的读者。
one_line: IGDS selects SFT data that activates causally validated internal task features.
该方法先用因果干预确认模型内部的任务特征，再选择最能激活这些特征的监督微调样本。
why: It turns feature-level interpretability evidence into a concrete training-data selection rule.
inclusion_reason: Selects SFT records through causal internal features, directly connecting a data record to the downstream optimization objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most SFT selectors rank examples by surface quality, loss, or diversity. Those signals can preserve plausible-looking records without showing that they exercise the internal mechanism a particular model needs for a target task; a selector may therefore spend budget on examples that are fluent but do not strengthen reasoning, translation, or summarization behavior.

IGDS asks whether an interpretable, causally useful model feature can become the criterion for choosing training records. It treats a candidate example as useful when it strongly activates a feature whose intervention has already improved held-out task performance, then uses the selected subset for supervised fine-tuning rather than changing decoding at inference time.

多数监督微调数据选择器按表面质量、损失或多样性给样本排序。这些信号可以保留看似合理的记录，却不能证明它们会触发某个模型完成目标任务所需的内部机制；因此，筛选器可能把训练预算花在语言流畅、但并不能增强推理、翻译或摘要能力的样本上。

IGDS 追问：能否把可解释且经因果验证的模型特征变成训练记录的选择标准。它将候选样本视为有用，当且仅当该样本强烈激活某个已经通过干预而提升留出任务表现的特征；随后方法用选出的子集进行监督微调，而不是在推理阶段改写解码过程。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a bridge from mechanistic evidence to a data decision. IGDS first uses sparse autoencoders to identify frequently active candidate features, then keeps only features whose amplification produces a positive change on a small validation set. It scores every training record by the combined activation of that causal feature set and fine-tunes on the highest-ranked subset.

The relevant object is not a newly released dataset but an existing instruction-response record plus its feature-resonant score. The feedback contract is task performance under intervention during feature validation, followed by ordinary SFT; this differs from selectors that trust an external judge, a low loss, or semantic coverage without asking whether the chosen examples reinforce a causal task mechanism.

这项工作的贡献，是在机制层面的证据与数据决策之间建立桥梁。IGDS 先使用稀疏自编码器识别经常激活的候选特征，再只保留那些在小型验证集上被放大后能带来正向表现变化的特征。它按这些因果特征集合的总激活量给每条训练记录打分，并对排名最高的子集进行微调。

这里的关键对象不是新发布的数据集，而是既有的指令—回答记录及其特征共振分数。其反馈契约是：先在特征验证中观察干预后的任务表现，再进行常规监督微调；这不同于只相信外部评判器、低损失或语义覆盖度、却不检验所选样本是否强化因果任务机制的选择器。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method separates a small feature-identification set, a larger candidate pool, and a final test set. For an instruction-tuned model, a sparse autoencoder converts hidden states at a task-specific position into sparse features. High-frequency features are only candidates: IGDS adds each feature's influence vector to the residual stream on validation examples and ranks it by the resulting task-performance gain.

It then freezes the validated feature set, computes a Feature-Resonant Score for each candidate record, and retains the top fraction for SFT of the corresponding base model. The reported math pool has 93.7K OpenR1-Math-220k examples and is evaluated on MATH-500 with pass@8; summarization and translation use separate DialogSum and WMT24/WMT24++ splits. Reuse requires the exact SAE, layer and token position, intervention protocol, split boundaries, and selection ratio.

该方法把小型特征识别集、较大的候选池和最终测试集分开。对于一个指令微调模型，稀疏自编码器把任务特定位置的隐藏状态转换成稀疏特征。高频特征只能算候选：IGDS 会在验证样本上把每个特征的影响向量加入残差流，并按由此产生的任务表现增益给它排序。

随后，它固定通过验证的特征集合，为每条候选记录计算特征共振分数，并保留排名靠前的一部分用于对应基座模型的监督微调。论文中的数学候选池含 93.7K 条 OpenR1-Math-220k 样本，并以 MATH-500 的 pass@8 评测；摘要和翻译分别使用独立的 DialogSum 与 WMT24/WMT24++ 划分。复用时必须固定 SAE、层和 token 位置、干预协议、数据划分边界及选择比例。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The decisive math comparison fine-tunes Gemma-2-2B on selected OpenR1-Math records and evaluates MATH-500. With a 50% sampling rate, IGDS reaches 37.8 accuracy, whereas removing frequency recall gives 29.2 and removing causal filtering gives 33.0; the paper also reports that IGDS exceeds full-data fine-tuning by 17.4% on this setting. These comparisons isolate both stages of the proposed selector rather than merely comparing a small subset with a full corpus.

The paper further evaluates Gemma-2, LLaMA-3.1, and Qwen3 across math, DialogSum summarization, and English-to-Chinese translation, against random, loss, IFD, and ZIP selection. This supports cross-task data efficiency, but not a guarantee that an SAE feature discovered for one model, dataset, or layer transfers to a different architecture or a changing production corpus.

最关键的数学比较是在选出的 OpenR1-Math 记录上微调 Gemma-2-2B，并用 MATH-500 评测。在 50% 采样率下，IGDS 达到 37.8 的准确率；去掉高频召回后为 29.2，去掉因果过滤后为 33.0；论文还报告该设置相对全量数据微调提高 17.4%。这些比较分别检验了所提选择器的两个阶段，而不只是把小子集与完整语料相比。

论文还在 Gemma-2、LLaMA-3.1 和 Qwen3 上评测数学、DialogSum 摘要与英译中，并与随机、损失、IFD 和 ZIP 选择进行比较。这支持其跨任务的数据效率主张，但不能保证为某一模型、数据集或层发现的 SAE 特征能迁移到不同架构或持续变化的生产语料。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior selectors generally value examples through output quality, difficulty, likelihood, or coverage. IGDS changes the auditable decision object: a record is chosen because it activates a feature that has passed an explicit causal intervention test, not merely because a judge liked its answer or an embedding made it diverse.

Sparse autoencoders and activation interventions are not new, nor is SFT subset selection. The new combination uses them in sequence to turn a model-internal causal claim into a reusable ranking rule. Before treating that rule as a training signal, inspect whether the intervention score is stable across seeds and whether its selected records remain beneficial when the base model, SAE, or task distribution changes.

既有选择器通常通过输出质量、难度、似然或覆盖度衡量样本价值。IGDS 改变了可审计的决策对象：一条记录被选中，是因为它激活了已经通过明确因果干预测试的特征，而不只是因为评判器喜欢它的回答，或因为嵌入表示让它显得更多样。

稀疏自编码器、激活干预和监督微调子集选择本身都不是新事物。新的组合在于按顺序使用这些工具，把关于模型内部因果机制的主张变成可复用的排序规则。在将该规则视为训练信号前，应检查干预分数是否跨随机种子稳定，以及更换基座模型、SAE 或任务分布后，所选记录是否仍然有益。

title: Limitations
局限
html: IGDS assumes that a sparse feature extracted at a chosen layer and token position is a faithful handle on the desired capability; correlated features or an imperfect SAE can make a positive intervention look more causal than it is. Feature identification also needs an instruction-tuned model, task-specific validation data, and intervention computation before SFT, so it is more demanding than a one-pass loss filter. The paper does not publish a dedicated code or data release URL, which makes exact replication of SAE training, positions, and preprocessing a required check rather than an assumed capability.
IGDS 假定：在指定层和 token 位置提取出的稀疏特征，是目标能力的可靠把手；相关特征或不完美的 SAE 可能让一次正向干预看起来比实际更具因果性。特征识别还需要指令微调模型、任务特定验证数据和干预计算，之后才能进行监督微调，因此它比一次性的损失过滤要求更高。论文没有发布专门的代码或数据链接，使 SAE 训练、位置选择和预处理的精确复现成为必须检查的事项，而不能默认它们已具备。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use IGDS when an SFT project has a large pool, a measurable target task, and access to model activations or suitable SAEs. Build a small held-out feature-validation set, identify and intervene on candidate features, score the pool, and compare the selected subset with random and full-data SFT under the same budget. Report the model/SAE pair, layer, position, score threshold, upstream licenses, and test split; do not use it as evidence that every highly activated example is correct, or when causal feature validation cannot be run.
当监督微调项目拥有较大候选池、可测量的目标任务，以及模型激活或合适 SAE 的访问条件时，可以使用 IGDS。先建立小型留出特征验证集，识别并干预候选特征，再给候选池打分，并在相同预算下将所选子集与随机和全量监督微调比较。应报告模型/SAE 组合、层、位置、分数阈值、上游许可证和测试划分；当无法运行因果特征验证时，不应把它当作证据，也不能据此认定所有高激活样本都正确。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The essential move is to make “what the model should practice” an internal, testable property rather than a generic quality score. Keep the three-way split explicit: feature-identification examples, selectable training records, and final evaluation data have different roles. The causal filter is what separates the method from frequency-only activation ranking. The strongest reported case is 50% math-data selection for Gemma-2-2B, so do not generalize the 17.4% figure to every task. Treat the absence of a dedicated artifact release as a reproducibility risk.
最应记住的动作，是把“模型应练习什么”定义为内部且可检验的属性，而不是泛化的质量分数。必须明确三种数据划分：特征识别样本、可选择的训练记录和最终评测数据承担不同角色。因果过滤使该方法区别于只按激活频率排序。最强的报告结果是为 Gemma-2-2B 选择 50% 数学数据，因此不能把 17.4% 的数字推广到所有任务。专门 artifact 发布的缺失应被视为可复现性风险。
